data.title: 白金 · 休息室的偷懒午后
data.description: 【罗德岛生活区干员休息室·午后】阳光斜斜落在米色软皮沙发上，白金慵懒地蜷着腿靠在抱枕堆里，手里翻着刚到的卡西米尔潮流时尚杂志，桌上摆着吃了一半的蓝莓慕斯蛋糕，神情惬意自得。
data.action: 侧卧沙发翻看时尚杂志
data.lighting: 百叶窗倾泻而下的柔和自然光斑
data.camera: 俯角中景，完整收纳沙发与茶几甜点
data.promptProse: In a bright modern lounge bathed in golden afternoon sunlight, Platinum reclines sideways on a plush leather sofa surrounded by cushions. She lazily flips through an open glossy magazine while nibbling on a slice of blueberry cheesecake. Warm sunbeams cast soft window shadows across her relaxed posture and soft white hair.
